categories.main_business_segments: Yunnan Aluminium Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: bauxite mining and alumina production, electrolytic aluminum production and aluminum processing, and other operations including logistics and alumina trading. The company produces alumina, electrolytic aluminum, carbon products, aluminum alloys, and processed aluminum products, serving various industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced electrolytic aluminum production technologies powered predominantly by clean energy, including photovoltaic direct current integration. It utilizes resource recycling technologies such as aluminum ash and anode slag comprehensive utilization, and has developed proprietary technologies in aluminum alloy welding materials, energy-saving electrolytic processes, and intelligent manufacturing systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in automotive lightweighting, aerospace, rail transit, electronics, packaging, and defense. The company serves domestic markets extensively and has established stable supply chains with leading domestic and international enterprises, leveraging its green aluminum brand.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Yunnan Province, China, with production bases in multiple locations such as Kunming, Wenshan, and Qujing. The company benefits from Yunnan's abundant green energy resources and strategic location near Southeast Asia, facilitating access to domestic and regional markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunnan Aluminium operates an integrated upstream to midstream supply chain, covering bauxite mining, alumina refining, electrolytic aluminum production, carbon products manufacturing, and aluminum alloy processing. This vertical integration enhances cost control and resource security.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes green, low-carbon development and technological innovation, focusing on energy efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and high-end aluminum alloy development. R&D efforts target advanced materials for rail transit, aluminum ash resource utilization, red mud comprehensive recycling, and intelligent manufacturing, supported by multiple provincial and national innovation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electrolytic aluminum, alumina, aluminum alloy products, and carbon materials. The company operates mainly on a product sales model with self-operated sales channels, serving industrial customers domestically.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunnan Aluminium is positioned as a leading green aluminum supplier in China, recognized as the largest domestic producer of green low-carbon aluminum. It holds a competitive advantage through its integrated green aluminum production chain and advanced technology, competing with other major Chinese aluminum producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 59.7 billion, a 27.6% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.41 billion, up 11.5%. Total assets reached RMB 41.9 billion, with steady growth in production volumes and profitability, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunnan Aluminium emphasizes its unique value proposition of green, low-carbon aluminum production powered by over 80% clean energy, significantly reducing carbon emissions compared to coal-based aluminum. It offers a fully integrated green aluminum supply chain certified by ASI standards, delivering high-quality, environmentally friendly aluminum products with strong technological innovation and resource recycling capabilities.
